evals.prompt: Find the best coworking space websites for design inspiration — ranked list with links, what tech stacks they run, and a preview image or two of the top ones.
evals.expected_output: Runs cowork-space-scout: Perplexity design-hub discovery (domain-filtered) + Exa neural search + Twitter chatter, picks the top showcase, then deep-dives it (Firecrawl extract, BuiltWith tech stack, ScreenshotOne preview). Outputs an aggregated JSON shortlist with URLs, tech stacks, and preview asset links plus a plain-language briefing.
assertions: cowork-space-scout is selected
